text:
alex: Noticed customers getting charged twice when a stream hits a region-fallback and the client reconnects. Small thread dump: 
alex: original stream starts -> soft-batch provisional(90 tokens)
vik: router: fallback to region-west -> emits provisional(40 tokens)
paz: final_confirm shows 130 tokens but ledger shows two provisional rows that weren’t deduped.
billing-bot: flag: 7 sessions, ~$28 provisional duplication in last 6h
paz: Root cause seems to be mismatch in batch windows — soft-batch used window [t0,t0+5s], fallback used [t0+5s,t0+10s] even though they map to same client session. Ledger dedupe keyed by batch_id so it misses overlap.
vik: Quick mitigation: ledger should de-duplicate by (session_id, floor(window_start/5s)) for a short period. Longer term: unify windowing logic across router and fallback so batch_ids map.
alex: Also want a console metric: provisional_emits_per_session with histogram and a small alert if count>1 in 30s. Add trace links to the dashboard so support can jump from session->trace->ledger rows.
paz: I'll file a console ticket and add the metric to the rollout checklist. If we go with the ledger-side dedupe we can run a backfill to mark duplicates and auto-refund provisional credits.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: region-fallback-dedupe-2026-03-12
alex: will post canary logs in 30m. If it reduces duplicate provisional emits we ship the ledger rule and open a support runbook.
